name: transmembrane protein 147

function.text: TMEM147 is the approved symbol for transmembrane protein 147. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in ribosome binding; multi-pass transmembrane protein insertion into ER membrane; protein localization to nuclear inner membrane.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include neurodevelopmental disorder with facial dysmorphism, absent language, and pseudo-pelger-huet anomaly (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Glioblastoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; Strong GenCC assertion, Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific review required.

function.text: TMEM147 encodes transmembrane protein 147. Its functions include ribosome binding and multi-pass transmembrane protein insertion into ER membrane.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include neurodevelopmental disorder with facial dysmorphism, absent language, and pseudo-pelger-huet anomaly (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TMEM147 have been reported in glioblastoma, endometrial carcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
